name_reason: Compliant with global naming convention: data_fd2_ prefix + domain-appropriate descriptor (chinese_font_sheet). No Ghidra address residue. 'font sheet' already conveys the asset/data character. Same-family siblings (data_fd2_tile_anim_table_base, data_fd2_ui_anim_sprite_sheet_ptr) carry _base/_ptr suffixes to mark the pointer type, so this one is stylistically slightly inconsistent, but the descriptor unambiguously identifies the data; adding a _ptr suffix would be cosmetic only and not worth the Stage-2 ripple across protos.h/globals.h/callsites. Keep.
purpose: Base pointer to the loaded Chinese glyph sprite sheet (FDOTHER.DAT resource index 4); supplies the font_data source for the dialog glyph blitter.
logic_summary: uint32 address slot, zero-initialized in BSS (.object2). main() writes it once at startup: data_fd2_chinese_font_sheet = fd2_load_dat_resource(FDOTHER.DAT, data_fd2_chinese_font_sheet, 4) -- the in-place reload pattern hands the previous pointer back as the reusable buffer (this is the [READ] at 0x25ccd) and stores the fresh pointer (the [WRITE] at 0x25ce0). The dialog bytecode VM fd2_display_dialog_scene reads it (0x16113, 0x16471) and passes it as the first argument (font_data) to fd2_blit_glyph_2bpp_with_outline, which indexes into the sheet by glyph id to draw each character -- used both on the literal-number opcode path (-6, digit glyphs offset by 0x30) and the general TEXT path.
datatype: uint32 (heap pointer to glyph sprite-sheet blob)
element_semantics: Single 4-byte pointer value. Holds the base address of the FDOTHER.DAT resource-4 glyph sheet; consumed as the font_data parameter of fd2_blit_glyph_2bpp_with_outline (the byte glyph index selects a glyph within the sheet).
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate but slightly redundant ('uint32 address slot; zero-init (BSS) pointer slot' repeats slot/pointer) and lacked reader/writer context that sibling globals document.
notes: Memory at 0x53A75 reads all zeros (BSS, no static initializer), consistent with a runtime resource pointer. fd2-knowledge offset lookup has no entry (expected: not a strategy-guide static table). Primary Ghidra symbol is exactly 'data_fd2_chinese_font_sheet' (the leading-underscore form in decompiler output is Ghidra's namespace-collision display artifact). src declaration uint32 data_fd2_chinese_font_sheet; matches globals.h extern at line 374. fd2_blit_glyph_2bpp_with_outline prototype (protos.h:666) takes uint32 font_data as arg0, confirming element semantics.
